lead.t: Reticular activating system (RAS) – maintains arousal; disruption produces the inattention of delirium.

snip.t: Reticular activating system (RAS) – maintains arousal; disruption produces the inattention of delirium.
Altered consciousness – from lethargy to coma: Progressive compression of the reticular activating system as ICP rises.
Altered level of consciousness (GCS <15): Direct compression of the ascending reticular activating system.
Pathogenesis: Likely involves dysregulation of the reticular activating system in the brainstem (exact mechanism unknown).
